item.title: Anthropic successfully completes largest IPO in history, valued at $1.5T
item.description: As we previewed on our Know Before You IPO pod, Anthropic set its IPO price at $83 and today $ANT closed at $97.17, up 17% from the offering price ( drifting -5% to $92.60 after the close). Employee wealth: The average employee could be worth >$40M, per SEC filings and investors ( @kimmonismus ). Dario and Daniela ( Dario’s remarks, Founders’ letter ) used the occasion to say Anthropic would pace training and deployment based on whether it could keep its systems safe and under human control. — Upstream (Swyx · Latent Space): https://latent.space/p/ainews-anthropic-successfully-completes-largest-ipo-in-history-valued-at-1-5t/

item.title: Scaling Linear’s GTM to $100M ARR — Cristina Cordova, COO
item.description: Open video on YouTube ↗ Linear was founded to build a better issue tracker. We talk about why she stopped chasing enterprise deals three weeks after joining, why Linear has never hired a single SDR, why it won't let an AI assistants answer support tickets on its own, and what the AI budgets behind $100M-in-months ARR mean for everyone else. Since then it has shipped a universal app connector server, a platform for building agents into Linear, integrations with Codex, Cursor and GitHub Copilot, and its own Linear Agent. — Upstream (Swyx · Latent Space): https://latent.space/p/linear-scaling/
